description: Post-implementation report — agent builds a complete implementation report from real data and presents it for PO decision
template:
📌 IMPLEMENT.REPORT_GATE - Post-implementation Report (PO Review)

🧑‍💻 You are the **Developer**.
Your job is to BUILD A COMPLETE IMPLEMENTATION REPORT from real data
and present it to the PO for review.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEP 0: BUILD THE REPORT FROM REAL DATA
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Before presenting to the user, you MUST:

1. READ the context layers above (TASK, STATE, PROJECT, CPG, CKG)
2. QUERY the CPG to verify the implementation actually exists:
   walker <project>/kg_multi '{"cpg":{"file":"<migrated_area>"},"ckg":{"type":"decision"}}'
3. SYNTHESIZE the data into the report template below
4. PRESENT the complete report to the user
5. ONLY THEN offer the decision options

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
IMPLEMENTATION REPORT — {task_id}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## Objective (from TASK layer)
<task.objective>

## What Was Delivered (from STATE + CPG layers)
- <delivery item 1: files created/modified>
- <delivery item 2: shims/compatibility>
- <delivery item 3: tests>

## Modified Files (verify via CPG query)
- <file> -> <status: created/modified/deleted>
- <file> -> <status>

## Acceptance Criteria Status
- [PASS/FAIL] <predicate 1> — <evidence from CPG verification>
- [PASS/FAIL] <predicate 2> — <evidence>

## Deviations from Plan
- <deviation 1> -> <reason> (or "No deviations")

## Knowledge Captured
- Decisions: <N>
- Rules:     <N>
- Warnings:  <N>

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Now present this report to the user and ask:

  Options:
    . proceed -> implementation accepted, proceed to verification (VERIFY.QA_RUN)
    . refine  -> needs refinement (REFINE.DIAGNOSE)
    . cancel  -> cancel task, return to sprint (SPRINT.ACTIVE)

  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"proceed","evidence":"User accepts implementation: <summary>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"refine","evidence":"<what to fix>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"cancel","evidence":"<reason>"}'
